create_escher_agent: create an ESCHER agent for an OpenSpiel game with configurable value, regret, and average policy networks
train_escher_agent: train an ESCHER agent using regret matching, value estimation, and average policy optimization over multiple iterations
get_action_probabilities: get action probabilities for a given game state using the trained average policy network
calculate_nashconv: calculate the NashConv of the current ESCHER policy to measure exploitability
evaluate_vs_random: evaluate an ESCHER agent's performance by playing games against random policies
